fields.application_url_desc: Enter the full application URL here. It will be used in notification emails.
fields.application_name_desc: Enter an application title here. It is used at several locations, e.g. the HTML header, menu and other pages where the title is referenced.
fields.application_manual_desc: The user manual is maintained in English and is available at the Lewe Gitbook site. If you have written your own manual, enter the link here. It will be displayed in the Help menu as long as the field is not empty.
fields.html_description_desc: Enter an application description here. It will be used in the HTML header for search engines.
fields.html_keywords_desc: Enter application keywords here. It will be used in the HTML header for search engines.
fields.default_language_desc: Select the default language here. Users can switch languages in the UI.
fields.alert_show_desc: Select what type of alerts (toast messages) will be shown.
fields.alert_autoclose_info_desc: Select whether Info alerts shall be automatically closed after the amount of milliseconds specified below.
fields.alert_autoclose_success_desc: Select whether Success alerts shall be automatically closed after the amount of milliseconds specified below.
fields.alert_autoclose_warning_desc: Select whether Warning alerts shall be automatically closed after the amount of milliseconds specified below.
fields.alert_autoclose_error_desc: Select whether Error alerts shall be automatically closed after the amount of milliseconds specified below.
fields.alert_autoclose_delay_desc: Enter the amount of milliseconds after which alerts the selected alert types above shall be automatically closed (e.g. 4000 = 4 seconds).
fields.matomo_analytics_desc: The application supports Matomo Analytics. If you want to track access to your instance, you can check this box and enter your Matomo URL and SiteId below.
fields.matomo_url_desc: If you enabled the Matomo Analytics feature, enter the URL where your Matomo server is hosted.
fields.matomo_siteid_desc: If you enabled the Matomo Analytics feature, enter the Matomo Site ID here.
fields.disable_search_engines_desc: With this switch on, search engine robots are instructed not to index the pages of this LeweDesk website. The public pages (landing page, About, Privacy Policy and Imprint) carry fixed SEO tags and are not affected.
fields.disable_caching_desc: In some server-client environments you might experience unwanted caching effects. With this option activated, LeweDesk sends No-caching instructions to the web server that might help.
fields.debug_mode_desc: With this switch on, debugging information is displayed in the browser console.
fields.under_maintenance_desc: With this switch on, the application is put into maintenance mode. Only administrators can access the application.
fields.allow_registration_desc: Lets visitors create their own account on the registration page. Turn this off to manage users manually; administrators can still create users.
fields.force_2fa_desc: Forces users to setup a two factor authentication, e.g. via Google or Microsoft Authenticator. If a user has not setup 2FA yet, he will be redirected to a Setup 2FA page after regular login.
fields.audit_retention_days_desc: Enter after how many days audit log entries are deleted. Enter 0 to keep them forever.
fields.admin_page_size_desc: Defines how many rows are shown per page on system configuration pages.
fields.color_mode_desc: Select the default color mode of the application.
fields.font_desc: Select the font to use for the application.
fields.index_brand_icon_desc: Bootstrap Icons class shown in the navbar and the sidebar, e.g. bi-headset. Leave empty for the default icon.
fields.index_brand_title_desc: Title shown in the navbar and the sidebar. Leave empty for the default title.
fields.index_hero_title_left_desc: Left part of the hero title, shown in the normal text color. Leave a part empty to keep the default for it.
fields.index_hero_title_right_desc: Right part of the hero title, shown highlighted.
fields.index_hero_subtitle_desc: Text below the hero title. Leave empty for the default text.
fields.index_copyright_company_desc: Company name in the footer copyright line. The year is added automatically. Leave empty for the default.
fields.index_copyright_url_desc: Optional web address (http or https) the company name links to. Without it the name is shown as plain text.
fields.default_product_id_desc: The product of new issues that name none, for example the issues made from mails. The key of the product is the prefix of the issue keys (e.g. LD-123).
fields.support_email_desc: Enter the email address of your support team here. A message is sent to this address when an issue is created.
fields.attachment_max_size_desc: Enter the maximum size of a single attachment or inline image in megabytes. The PHP settings upload_max_filesize and post_max_size of your web server must allow this size.
fields.attachment_max_count_desc: Enter the maximum number of attachments of an issue. Inline images in comments and descriptions count as attachments.
fields.attachment_max_total_size: Maximum Total Attachment Size per Issue (MB)
fields.attachment_max_total_size_desc: Enter the maximum total size of all attachments of an issue in megabytes.
fields.rate_limit_issues_desc: Enter how many issues a user may create per hour. Agents and Administrators are not limited. Enter 0 to switch the limit off.
fields.rate_limit_comments_desc: Enter how many comments a user may add per hour. Agents and Administrators are not limited. Enter 0 to switch the limit off.
fields.notification_retention_days_desc: Enter after how many days in-app notifications are deleted.
fields.notification_poll_interval_desc: Enter how often the browser checks for new notifications.
fields.temp_upload_cleanup_hours_desc: Images that were uploaded while writing a new issue are deleted after this many hours if the issue was never saved.
fields.lic_expiry_warning_desc: Enter how many days before the license expires administrators are warned with a banner on every page. Enter 0 for no warning.
fields.provider_contact_desc: Name and address of the provider, one line each. Shown as controller in the privacy policy and as provider in the imprint.
fields.provider_phone_desc: Phone number of the provider in international format, e.g. +49 6105 123456. Leave empty to hide it.
fields.provider_email_desc: Email address of the provider. Leave empty to hide it.
fields.provider_website_desc: Website of the provider, starting with http:// or https://. Leave empty to hide it.
fields.mailin_poll_interval_desc: How often the mailbox is read, at the earliest. Reading happens after a request to the application, so it needs some traffic.
fields.mailin_default_type_desc: Type of the issues that are made from mails.
fields.mailin_default_product_desc: Product of the issues that are made from mails.
fields.mailin_default_access_desc: Who can see the issues that are made from mails. "Reporter only" is the safe choice: the sender and the support team.
fields.mailin_unknown_sender_desc: What happens with mails from addresses that no user has. Both ways other than "Reject" need the proof of the mail server that the sender owns the address.
fields.mailin_send_confirmation_desc: Send the sender of a mail the issue key when an issue was made from it.
fields.mailin_trust_sender_desc: Accept the address of a user without the proof of the mail server (SPF, DKIM, DMARC). Never for support staff and administrators. Only for a mailbox that receives mails from inside.
fields.mailin_max_mails_per_run_desc: The most mails that are handled in one check. The others wait for the next one.
fields.mailin_max_body_size_desc: The text of a mail is cut off after this size.
fields.mailin_hourly_limit_desc: The most mails that may become issues or comments within an hour. The others wait in the mailbox. 0 means no limit.
fields.mailin_allowed_domains_desc: Only mails from these domains are handled (one per line or separated by commas, subdomains included). Empty: every domain.
fields.mailin_blocked_domains_desc: Mails from these domains are always rejected.

license.key_desc: Enter the license key you received and click Save Key. After saving the key, click Activate to register this domain with the license server.

respond.title: Respond
respond.text: Your response is added as a comment. The status changes to show who is expected to answer next.

resolve.title: Resolve issue
resolve.text: Select how the issue was resolved. The status changes to Resolved.

reopen.title: Reopen issue
reopen.text: Say why the issue is reopened. The status changes to Open and the resolution is cleared.

assign.title: Assign issue
assign.text: Select the Agent who takes care of the issue.

move.title: Move issue
move.text: The issue gets the next number of the product you select, so its key changes. The old key keeps working. The affected and the fixed version are cleared, because versions belong to a product.

change_access.title: Change access
change_access.text: Who may see this issue? Watchers who lose access are removed.
change_access.text_reporter: You can only restrict the access of your issue, not widen it again. Watchers who lose access are removed.

delete.title: Delete issue

landing.hero_lead: LeweDesk is the helpdesk and ticket management system by Lewe Labs. Report issues, request improvements and follow every case from the first message to the solution.
landing.features_lead: A focused set of tools to collect, organize and resolve customer reports.

issues.title: Issue tracking
issues.text: Report issues and request improvements. Every issue has a type, status, product, tags, markdown description, comments and a full history.

workflow.title: Configurable workflow
workflow.text: Define your own issue types, statuses, resolutions and products so the helpdesk follows the way your team works.

access.title: Fine-grained access control
access.text: Roles, groups and permissions decide who sees what. Issues are public, visible to registered users or private to the reporter.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.text: Stay informed with in-app and email notifications, set up per user and per event.

attachments.title: Attachments and search
attachments.text: Attach files to issues and comments, and find any issue quickly with the built-in search and saved views.

security.title: Secure by design
security.text: Two-factor authentication, optional LDAP or SSO (OIDC), spam protection and an audit log keep your data safe.

register.title: Create an account
register.text: Register in a minute, or sign in with your existing account.

report.title: Report an issue
report.text: Describe the problem or your idea, add screenshots and pick the product it concerns.

follow.title: Follow it to resolution
follow.text: Get notified about every comment and status change until the issue is resolved.

what.a: LeweDesk is a web-based customer support helpdesk and ticket management system by Lewe Labs. Customers report issues and request improvements, and support staff track them to resolution.

who.a: Software vendors and service teams that want a structured, central place for customer reports, feature requests and support conversations.

languages.a: The interface is available in English, German, French and Spanish.

private.a: Each issue is either public, visible to registered users only, or private to the person who reported it. Internal comments stay hidden from reporters.

policies.title: SLA policies
policies.intro: A policy sets how fast issues must get a first response and be resolved. The policies with conditions are tried in the order of the sort order, and the first one that matches an issue applies. The default policy (no conditions) applies to all other issues.
policies.confirm_delete: Delete the selected policy? A policy that has timers of issues cannot be deleted; deactivate it instead.
policies.name_desc: Unique name of the policy (max. 100 characters).
policies.description_desc: Short description of when the policy applies.
policies.conditions_desc: The policy applies to issues that match all conditions you set. Leave a condition on "Any" to ignore it.
policies.default_notice: A policy without conditions is the default policy for all issues no other policy matches. There can be only one.
policies.calendar_desc: The opening hours in which the clock runs. Without a calendar the clock runs around the clock.
policies.targets_desc: How long the team has for the first response and the resolution, counted in working time of the calendar. Leave a field empty for no target.
policies.targets_hint: A day is 24 hours of working time. The row "All other priorities" applies to every priority that has no row of its own.
policies.warning_desc: The share of the target after which an issue is marked as at risk.
policies.pause_statuses_desc: The clock does not run while an issue has one of these statuses (for example while it waits for the customer).
policies.sort_order_desc: Policies with a lower number are tried first. Leave empty to put a new policy last. The default policy has no place in the order: it applies when no other policy matches.
policies.active_desc: Only active policies apply to issues.

calendars.title: SLA calendars
calendars.intro: A calendar tells when the clock of an SLA runs: the opening hours of each weekday in a time zone. Holidays stop the clock for the whole day.
calendars.confirm_delete: Delete the selected calendar with its opening hours and holidays? A calendar that a policy uses cannot be deleted.
calendars.name_desc: Unique name of the calendar (max. 100 characters).
calendars.description_desc: Short description, for example the team or the location.
calendars.timezone_desc: The time zone of the opening hours. Daylight saving time is taken into account.
calendars.hours_desc: The times when the clock runs. A day can have several ranges (for example a lunch break). An end of 00:00 means the end of the day.
